origin.round: source-set bypass (Directory.Build.props injection; the shape samples/Directory.Build.props used to have)
origin.lens: a compile item outside the brick directory, declared where a csproj scan cannot see it

description: A Directory.Build.props beside the brick adds ../_shared/InjectedPayload.cs to the compilation. The csproj never mentions it, so a loader reading the csproj as XML and globbing *.cs in the directory hashed, fenced and mutated half the program and signed a certificate over it. The loader must take the source set from the evaluated project and refuse the outside item by name, before any build.
